fix: The kernel has encountered a 500. Start the DB terminal and verify uvicorn is running on port 8090. Check the .env for connection string integrity.
Port collision detected. Run `netstat -ano | findstr :8090` and terminate the conflicting process. Then restart the backend via PM2.
A required database table is absent. The Genesis Sequence should auto-create tables on boot. Trigger a hard restart of miracle-backend via PM2.
PostgreSQL sequence desync. Run SQL: `SELECT setval('table_id_seq', max(id)) FROM table;` to realign the auto-increment.
CORS policy rejection. Add the frontend domain to `allow_origins` in FastAPI `main.py`. Ensure `miracle.vigilantitsolution.com` is listed.
Pydantic validation failed. Check the Network tab — a required field in the request payload is missing or mistyped.
ORM Integrity breach. You are attaching a child record to a parent ID that does not exist. Verify the parent record first.
Session expired silently. The token has lapsed. Log out and log back in to generate a fresh authorization key.
BOM zero-divide error. A RAW ingredient has Factor = 0. Go to Inventory, find the RAW asset, and set Factor >= 1 to resolve.
Vault direct edit detected. Use the RECEIVING BAY to log deliveries — never type stock numbers directly. The factor multiplier will not fire otherwise.
Margin collapse. The Retail Price is below COGS. Increase RP in the Vault or renegotiate the Purchase Price with the vendor.
Physical stock variance. Compare Theoretical Stock in Inventory to the physical count. The delta is shrinkage — theft, spoilage, or over-portioning.
PAR level breach. Stock has fallen below the minimum threshold. Contact the vendor immediately and raise a Purchase Order.
Ghost folio charge. You cannot charge to a room unless the guest is IN-HOUSE. Verify the room status in the Command Grid first.
Double-entry bounce. The POS sale completed visually but failed to post to the accounting ledger. Check FastAPI logs for a missing category field mapping.
Settlement imbalance. The checkout logic failed to clear the Advance Deposit liability account. Run the checkout patch script to zero it before closing the folio.
Predatory discount applied. The discount exceeds the folio total. The system blocked it to prevent negative revenue. Adjust the discount downward.
Operative load desync. Click AUTHORIZE GLOBAL SYNC in HR to force the system to overwrite the frontend cache with live database state.
ROI multiplier failure. Update the COMM% for this operative in the HR Registry and sync. The revenue impact factor will recalculate.
Liability posting rejected. Ensure the Payroll Expense account exists in the Chart of Accounts before pushing payroll.
WebSocket silent drop. Refresh the Command Grid to re-establish the ws/grid-sync connection. If it persists, scale the ASGI worker count on the VPS.
Grid out of sync with DB. Force-pull /api/frontdesk/live-grid to wipe the frontend cache and reload from the physical database.
Check DNS first. Run `nslookup api.vigilantitsolution.com` — it must resolve to 23.88.50.87. If not, restore the A Records in cPanel Zone Editor.
DNS outage detected. Log in to cPanel at 148.251.78.240:2083, navigate to Zone Editor, and verify A Records point to 23.88.50.87.
Mission resolution deadlock. Only CDO can Force Resolve. Go to the Solve Portal and press the CDO override button.
Maintenance chrono leak. The lock was saved in Policy but not synced to the reservation engine. Ensure AssetGrid.current_status is updated.
